create.name: Ramana Maharshi Foundation UK
create.bio:
The Ramana Maharshi Foundation UK is a registered charity (no. 1040280) that gathers people in Britain, and visitors from abroad, around the teaching of Sri Ramana Maharshi of Tiruvannamalai: self-enquiry, or atma vichara, and surrender to the guru. It has no ashram of its own; its face-to-face meetings take place at Colet House in west London.

On the first Saturday of most months it holds a satsang there with reading, meditation, chanting and discussion, supported by donations. Much of its life is now online: Michael James gives Zoom talks twice a month on the verses of Guru Vachaka Kovai and answers questions, a meditation group meets three evenings a week and a study group works through core texts twice a week, and on the third Saturday guest speakers who knew or long studied the Ramana tradition, among them the writer David Godman and Michael Highburger of Sri Ramanasramam, give talks that are later posted on its YouTube channel. The Foundation also sends out a newsletter twice a year, supplies books on Ramana by post, and shares photographs of Bhagavan and recordings of devotional chants.

courses.title: Satsangs, meditation and study groups
courses.description: A monthly in-person satsang at Colet House, London, on the first Saturday at 2 pm, by donation, plus Zoom satsangs with Michael James twice a month, an online meditation group three evenings a week and a twice-weekly study group on core texts. Zoom links are sent on request by email.

free_resources.title: RMF UK Newsletter, Spring/Summer 2026
free_resources.description: The latest twice-yearly newsletter of the Foundation as a free PDF; earlier issues back to 2020 are linked from the same site.
